sloka: धर्मतो यो भवेद्विप्रः क्षत्रियो वीर्यतो भवेत् ।क्रोधाद्यश्च भवेदग्निः क्षान्त्या च वसुधासमः ।। ७.२६.३४ ॥
transliteration: dharmato yo bhavedvipraḥ kṣatriyo vīryato bhavet ।krodhādyaśca bhavedagniḥ kṣāntyā ca vasudhāsamaḥ ।। 7.26.34 ॥

translations.english: He (Nalakubara) is like a Brahmin by righteousness, a Kshatriya by valor, fire by his anger, and equal to the earth in patience.
